text_block_list.text:
Whew, that's a new personal best. If I
can keep
this up...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Кинг Хало rises early in the morning.
text_block_list.name: Монолог(?)

text_block_list.text:
She warms up an entire hour before
everyone
else. Today, she will embark
on a series of
grueling time trials with no
breaks in sight—
text_block_list.name: Монолог(?)

text_block_list.text:
Um, could you please not narrate my life
like
that?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Nyaha! It's not often you run on the dirt,
King. I
thought you hated it.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: You said it always pelts you in the face.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: That's why I run in the mornings.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It dawned on me when I was practicing
around
this time with my trainer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
An empty track is the best. You don't
get covered
in sand, and there's no one
to crowd you.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Huh, that's pretty smart. I never thought
about it
like that.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I also learned that innumerable
training
methods can be used on just
one track!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I'm someone who certainly
puts what I
learn to good use!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, you're a good girl who's
taking what
your trainer says to heart!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what?! Why did you phrase it like
that?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It seems that Кинг Хало has been
learning a lot
from training!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
